6425.title: Codex goal-clear acknowledgements violate the existing host contract
6425.rootCauseOneLine: The Codex goal-clear dispatch uses generic maintenance, which discards the native result and returns ok instead of the host-required cleared boolean.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed unmerged PR addresses the same mechanism; no branch was executed.

6425.proposedFix: Parse and forward goal-clear results through a dedicated existing-contract handler; preserve booleans and native errors, normalize legacy acknowledgements.
6425.caveats: No live Codex or Windows verification. Initial unrelated full build failed on SDK/plugin ordering; targeted prerequisites and all provider tests pass.
